nome_jp: 吸血男爵 シャドウ
testo:
■ When you put this creature into your graveyard from anywhere, if you have 3 or more darkness cards in your mana zone, choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone. That creature gets -2000 power until the end of the turn. (A creature that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
Double Breaker
